# Everforest for the Harness web interface
The pack ships six Everforest palettes for the Harness web interface. Each palette pairs a depth wit
h a light or dark plane.
## Features

- 🌿 **Upstream colors**: every color comes from Everforest.
- 🌓 **Six palettes**: hard, medium and s

oft, each in light and dark.
- 🎨 **All surfaces**: all 154 base tokens get Everforest colors.
- ⌨️ *

*Syntax included**: code blocks use Everforest highlight groups.
- 🧩 **No setup**: the pack has no d
ependencies, install scripts or host configuration.
## Palettes
The depth sets contrast against the canvas. The plane selects the light or dark half.
| Depth | Light | Dark |

| Hard |  |  |
| Medium |  |  |
| Soft |  |  |
Medium is the default. Hard has the highest text contrast. Soft has the lowest.
## Install
Install the bundle from a Harness session with the plugin manager:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The target is the absolute path of a clone of this repository. You can also install from the Plugin
Manager page. Point that page at the same directory.
Reload the page after the first install. Open Settings → General → Everforest and select a depth.
## Choose a palette
The Settings row offers seven choices. Each choice sets the depth and the host theme preference.
| Choice | Effect |

| Default | Removes the Everforest layer and restores the built-in palette. |
| Dark Hard, Dark Medi

um, Dark Soft | Applies a dark plane and sets Appearance to Dark. |
| Light Hard, Light Medium, Ligh
t Soft | Applies a light plane and sets Appearance to Light. |
The depth stays in this browser and defaults to `medium`.
The three Appearance choices keep working on their own. Select System with a depth. The page then fo
llows the system light or dark setting.
## Known limits
Four limits are worth knowing before you install the pack:
- **First paint**: the Harness boot stylesheet paints the default background before Everforest loads

. This flash is cosmetic and unavoidable for a per-browser choice.
- **Defaults, not overrides**: co
mponents with deeper selectors keep their color. One example is the Plugin Manager destructive butto

n.
- **Untouched properties**: `--dsw-focus-ring-color`, shadows, radii and fonts stay unchanged. Tw

o static neutral tokens stay white for translucent highlights.
- **Per-browser depth**: the depth li
ves in this browser origin. It does not sync through the profile.
